$comment: Fields Claude extracts from an ad submission (creative image + headline + body copy + targeting metadata). Descriptions matter: they are the extraction instructions AND what the policy compiler reads to decide which field a rule should reference.

ad_category.description: Primary product/service category being advertised, judged from image and copy together.

brand_name.description: Advertiser brand as shown in the creative or copy; null if none visible.

headline_text.description: The headline as submitted (from metadata, not OCR).

disclaimer_present.description: True if the creative image contains any legal/responsibility disclaimer text (small print strip, age badge, APR line, etc.).

disclaimer_text.description: Verbatim disclaimer text read from the image, or null if none.

age_gate_shown.description: Minimum age displayed in the creative (e.g. 18 or 21 from an '18+' / '21+' badge); null if no age badge.

text_coverage.description: Rough share of the image area covered by overlaid text glyphs: low (<20%), medium (20-40%), high (>40%). Judge by the area the letters themselves occupy, not their bounding boxes or text regions; a headline plus small print and a badge on an otherwise clean image is low.

before_after_imagery.description: True if the creative shows a side-by-side or sequential before/after comparison of a person's body, skin, or face.

superlative_claims.description: Absolute or unverifiable claims found in headline, body, or image text — e.g. '#1', 'best', 'guaranteed', 'cure', 'instant results', 'risk-free'. Empty list if none.

health_claim_present.description: True if copy or image claims to treat, cure, prevent, or diagnose a medical condition.

price_or_rate_shown.description: True if a specific price, discount percentage, interest rate, or APR appears anywhere in the ad.

apr_disclosed.description: For financial ads that mention credit/loans/rates: true if a representative APR is stated. Null if not a credit product.

people_depicted.description: True if one or more real-looking people appear in the creative.

depicted_person_apparent_minor.description: If people are depicted: true if any appears to be under 18. Null if no people or genuinely indeterminate.

competitor_reference.description: True if the ad names or shows the logo of a brand other than the advertiser in a comparative way.

landing_url_domain.description: Domain of the click-through URL from metadata; null if not provided.

target_min_age.description: Minimum audience age from the submitted targeting metadata; null if advertiser left it unset.
